desc:
Slam it, tune it, turn it up! 🔊🚗

Pick a classic and make it yours: drop it on air suspension, fit new rims, paint, tint, neon and your own plate, then cruise the town and the highway with your speaker box shaking the street.

🚗 10 cars: Gol, Saveiro, Uno, Kombi, Polo GTI, Hilux and more
🎚️ Air suspension: raise and drop the front and rear on the move
🔊 Real sound systems: play your music for everyone nearby, with bass boost
🎨 Paint, rims, camber, tint, neon underglow, custom plates
💃 Emotes: dances, greetings and poses
🏆 Leaderboards for km driven, time played and cash
📱 PC, phone, tablet and console

👍 Like the game and join the group for free rewards!
